_comment: Frozen-probe heads of the DINOv3-SigLIP2 encoder (zo59vdxk, epoch 30) from heartwise/DeepECG-PNG_DINOv3-SigLIP2_epoch030 (the release manifest repository), served by models/dinov3_bank.py (DeepECG_Docker), plus the fully fine-tuned ACO model from heartwise/deepecg_clip_dinov3_acs (models/aco_finetune.py), both in one request (decision of 2026-11-26). variant: clean (probes fitted on clean rendered pages; PACS-AI receives native digital ECGs) or aug. heads: enabled probe tasks; disabled_heads are never loaded or returned.

aco.label: ACO (acute coronary occlusion), fully fine-tuned DINOv3
